card.name: Frequency and either-way adverbs opening a clause
card.fires_on: Sentence-leading or clause-leading adverbs like commonly, usually, typically, ultimately and either, placed before the main statement. It fires in general prose as well as in drug-label text.

modes.label: Frequency adverbs
modes.description: Usually, typically or commonly starts a sentence or clause and describes what is generally the case.
modes.example: <<Usually>> you need to use more than one shape

modes.label: Either / ultimately
modes.description: Either or ultimately introduces a summing-up or a choice between two outcomes.

card.plain: It marks words like usually, typically or either that open a clause and set up a general statement or a choice between two options.
